turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! How is your Monday starting off? Staying cool in the Phoenix heat today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Yes, it's scorching already. I'm just waking up and trying to cool down with a tall glass of that slow-steeped chilled coffee I prepared in the fridge. It's the only way to wake up for my shift.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds incredibly refreshing. Nothing beats a cold coffee when it's that hot out. Are you packing a lunch for your shift tonight?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I am! I actually just put together a turkey and swiss sandwich using a couple of thick slices of my latest homemade wild-yeast loaf. It turned out super tangy and perfect for a quick bite at the hospital.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Yum, your sourdough baking always sounds so delicious! Did Tom get to try a slice of this loaf too?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He did, he came over yesterday and we had some toast. He loved it! He's actually busy tonight, so I'll just be taking the late-night public transit bus to the hospital by myself.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It's nice you got to share some with him. How is the ride on the late bus usually? Do you use that time to read or listen to something?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Usually, I just throw my headphones on. Today I've got a hilarious stand-up comedy audio show queued up. It'll definitely keep me laughing and keep my energy up before a busy night in the ER.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A funny show is a great way to prep for a stressful shift! It's good to get some laughs in. Have you and Tom managed to get any salsa dancing in lately, or has it been too hot for that?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We actually haven't gone in about a week because of the heat, but we're hoping to hit the studio later this week when they have their air-conditioned social night. I really miss it!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: An air-conditioned social night sounds like the perfect compromise! I hope you two get to go. What time do you head out for the hospital tonight?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll probably walk to the stop in about an hour. The sun will be down, but it'll still be pretty warm. At least the bus has decent AC.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's a relief. Well, enjoy your comedy show on the ride over, and I hope you have a smooth, quiet night in the ER, Sofia!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'll talk to you tomorrow.
